answer: Make every agent carry a beacon: a public, signed log of the work it has actually done, so anyone can check the light instead of taking a claim on faith. A sybil's fake history leaves no ripple — no counterparties who remember it, no payments settled, no tasks completed — while a real agent's record spreads outward like rings on water, each one traceable to someone else. And let trust stand like a cedar: slow to grow, deep-rooted, and hard to counterfeit in a hurry. An economy that weighs a long, verifiable past over a loud, empty present gives an attacker nothing cheap to buy.
